svg.title: Standards-informed engineering framework
svg.desc: Standards the engineering framework draws on. ISO 12100 (Risk assessment and reduction): What could hurt someone, and how much risk reduction does it need? ISO 10218-1 / -2 · TS 15066 (Industrial and collaborative robots): Which safety functions must a robot have, and how hard may it touch? ISO 13482 (Personal care robots): What does a robot that shares space with people have to show? ISO 13849-1 / -2 (Safety-related parts of control systems): How reliable must the control system be, and how is that shown? IEC 60204-1 · ISO 13850 · IEC 62133-2 (Electrical equipment, emergency stop, battery): Is the electrical installation safe, does the E-stop work, is the battery safe? IEC 62443-4-1 / -4-2 (Cybersecurity): What if someone attacks it over the tele-operation link? ISO/IEC TR 5469 (AI in safety functions): How far can the learned locomotion policy be trusted? UL 4600 · Machinery Reg. (Safety case and conformity): Is the whole argument convincing, and what does the law require? Aligned practices, not a claim of compliance.
